summary: Draft candidate package for HiberFileSizePercent under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power. The clean Win25H2Clean baseline confirmed the current default, the repo power notes carry an exact docs hit, the residual string triage found an exact current-build ntoskrnl.exe hit, the repo power notes preserve the IDA-derived `PopHiberFileSizePercent` symbol note, and the guest-processed stepwise Procmon boot log on RegProbe-Baseline-Clean-20260329 captured an exact runtime read for HiberFileSizePercent. App surfacing remains a separate product decision from evidence classification.

setting.name: Hiber File Size Percent
setting.casual_explanation: Hiber File Size Percent is a low-level power-manager value under the main Power key that appears to relate to hibernation file sizing behavior.
setting.why_people_change_it: Researchers track this value when studying hibernation support, hiberfil sizing, and adjacent power-manager behavior.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The lane now has clean baseline existence, exact docs and static hits, a decompilation-derived internal symbol note, and an exact boot-time runtime read from the retained stepwise Procmon boot trace.
setting.professional_notes: Win25H2Clean phase-0 existence confirmed HiberFileSizePercent on the live baseline with preview value 0. The docs-first static triage tied the value to exact repo documentation hits, led by Docs/power/power.md:149, and the residual string batch found an exact current-build hit in C:\Windows\System32\ntoskrnl.exe. The same repo power notes preserve the IDA-derived internal symbol note `PopHiberFileSizePercent` for this value. A retained guest-processed stepwise Procmon boot trace on RegProbe-Baseline-Clean-20260329 then showed `smss.exe` performing an exact `RegQueryValue SUCCESS` on HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\HiberFileSizePercent with data 0 during the rebooted boot cycle. That stronger retained runtime proof supersedes the later lightweight ETW no-query lane as the best runtime layer for this candidate.
